menu_options.virtual: Virtual heater (simulated, for dev and demos)

real.title: Real heater
real.description: Point at the switch that controls the heater. The power and node status sensors are optional but let the app tell "on" from "on but unplugged", and "on" from "unreachable".

data_description.node_status_entity: On Z-Wave devices, the diagnostic "Node status" sensor. Without it a dead node still reports its last known state.
data_description.n_number: Matched against ScheduleMaster bookings. The leading N is optional.
data_description.auto_off: Set to zero to never turn the heater off automatically.

virtual.title: Virtual heater
virtual.description: A simulated heater with no hardware behind it, for local development and the demo.

abort.already_configured: That switch is already set up as a heater.

abort.yaml_managed: This heater is defined in configuration.yaml. Edit it there.
